text.text: The hotel is absolutely beautiful and I truly enjoyed my stay. The standout highlight of our trip was Alonzo. I’ve stayed at many high-end hotels, and Alonzo’s professionalism and efficiency are top-tier. He handled our requests with such speed and grace that it made our entire stay seamless. It’s clear he understands the industry inside and out. His attention to detail and proactive attitude are qualities you just can’t teach. He made us feel so valued that we’ve already decided this will be our 'go-to' hotel whenever we are in town. If the management team is looking for a model of what perfect customer service looks like, they need to look at Alonzo. The room was a perfect size and we had a balcony with a great view.

My husband and I traveled to Miami for the boat show and truly enjoyed our stay. While the rooms are on the smaller side and modest, they are exceptionally clean and very comfortable — exactly what you need after a full day at the show. It is evident that the housekeeping staff take great pride in ensuring cleanliness and comfort for their guests.

The location is fantastic. It’s within easy walking distance to the conference center, wonderful restaurants, and the beach, which made everything incredibly convenient. Additionally, the hotel restaurant was exceptional with “half price drinks” Happy Hour daily.

The true highlight of our visit, however, was Abdullah at the front desk. While others were not as accommodating, Abdullah was genuinely pleasant, kind, and  welcoming. More than that, he made it his personal mission to ensure our stay was comfortable and seamless. His attentiveness and positive spirit made a lasting impression on us.

We are grateful for the hospitality and would absolutely stay again.

text.text: We stayed here for 2 nights before a cruise. Hotel is a gem to look at, very smart and clean. Check-in was very quick and easy. Booked a cabana suite overlooking the lovely pool. Beach is right behind the hotel with a dedicated area for guests, well serviced by excellent staff. All the hotel staff we dealt with were very professional and friendly, particularly Max in the restaurant and the bar tender in the hotel bar (forget her name!). We did have an issue whilst there, as an event had been booked in the pool area that went on all day BUT, I raised the issue with the front desk manager and emailed the hotel afterwards and they all dealt with it very well, so no complaints. Would recommend for location, beach access, food, lovely hotel, great size suites and excellent staff.

The pool bar service was excellent. The staff were friendly, attentive, and did a great job, making time poolside enjoyable even if we didn’t want to get in the water.

What stood out most was not only the accommodation itself, but the manner in which it was delivered: calm, solutions-oriented, and with a clear commitment to guest experience. Please extend my thanks to Robert , and kindly note this recognition in his record. Service like that is the reason guests return—and why I have always valued properties that treat hospitality as an art.

Location was great. Beach, heated pool, and poolside service were appreciated. Cabana King room was very comfortable.

Equally impressive was Michael King, who exemplifies exceptional hospitality. Michael was courteous, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. His positive attitude and willingness to assist made a lasting impression.

It’s rare to encounter a parking team that elevates the entire hotel experience, but this group absolutely does. Their efficiency, professionalism, and heartfelt service reflect incredibly well on the property.

Bravo to Raoul, Michael, and the entire team for delivering five-star service from curbside to check-in. Truly exceptional hospitality!

First time I came to Lowes and with excitment because i thought its luxury hotel. Beautiful people at front desk, I agree.
But In reality this is a 3 star hotel with a disapointing service and this is why: my flight was delayed and I arrived at midnight, I was placed in an extension of the hotel and they were nice enough to move me back as I requested, into the main building with a nice size room and a balcony. Thank you for that.  However I dont understand that there was no complimentary water which as if we are talking about gold not water they would not give even one bottle. They gave me complementary drinks, but not water they have none in the building they said. i said but i dont drink alcohol and any sugary drinks all i need is water until the morning when I can see where to get some. Forget it, they would not give in haha i just dont get this. Its a pricey hotel. Housekeeping has to be requested otherwise your room is not going to be made, I mean come on. Umbrellas for the beach are extra they would not provide that but yes you will have chairs and towells…I had no idea about this either. So my take on this is dont waste your money here. Its not worth it.

text.text:
A Five-Star Stay with Historic Charm!
From the moment we walked in, we were captivated by the hotel's historic Art Deco feel. The architecture and design are truly stunning, giving the whole experience a wonderful, classic Miami Beach vibe. Our room was fantastic—clean, comfortable, and beautifully decorated.
What truly set this hotel apart was the amazing staff. Every single person we interacted with was friendly, professional, and went out of their way to be helpful.
The location is absolutely unbeatable. You're within easy walking distance of endless shopping and incredible food options. Plus, South Beach is right across the street! Despite being in a very lively area, I felt very safe and secure throughout my stay.
I can't recommend this hotel enough! It's the perfect blend of style, service, and location.

text.text:
Stayed for the weekend. The decor was lovely, with vintage photographs on the walls and dark flooring that added old-world charm. The bathroom was beautiful, and the bed was comfortable. The staff were very kind and genuinely tried to help and resolve any issues. Breakfast was a nice touch — good coffee, eggs with potatoes, and a super friendly server. There’s even a partial ocean view from the rooftop deck, and the location is great — an easy walk to everything.

However, this property does not feel like a true 4-star hotel, and it’s unclear why it carries the Curio brand, especially when compared to the Hotel del Coronado. We were disappointed to find that the main restaurant facing Collins Street was under construction — we had been looking forward to relaxing there after our days out. The lounge on the other side was closed as well, and even the front coffee bar wasn’t open. We were not informed about the remodeling when we booked well in advance.

Our room had a spacious patio, but the daybed needed cleaning. My side of the bed had no nightstand, and overall, the room could have used a deep clean. Unfortunately, the value didn’t match the experience.

Thank you anyway, and best of luck to the team.

text.text: Overpriced and not worth the money! I paid over $1200 for three nights. We arrived on Thursday. Left on Sunday, stayed in room 226 reservation for the first night was put under my friend‘s name but, reservation for the second night and third night was supposed to be put under my name because my credit card was used, but they kept it under my friend’s name. Rooms are overpriced and small. Only one elevator works and  housekeeping was horrible on the third day. Our room wasn’t cleaned after we indicated “service” by flipping on the GREEN LIGHT on the wall outside of the room so after being gone all morning and returning at 3 o’clock we were forced to be out in the street for more hours bc our room still wasn’t clean and we were sleepy and wanted to take naps. When they did clean the room they half ass cleaned it. Sink was still dirty from the morning, my bed had hair on it, sheets definitely were changed just beds remade (i have a feeding tube and the same stain was still on the sheets) we had to come in a 8:30p and request towels and wash clothes bc none were left. The accommodations were horrible! Servers were amazing at the restaurant for breakfast. Oh and on the last day we had to keep walking over a dead bird at the front entrance. I will never ever recommend this hotel to anyone and definitely will not be back… No fridge nor microwave either. That have a wine fridge.

The place was clean and cozy, especially for the good price on the room! Found a good deal on hopper $42 for one night in the room with the queen bed. Having a fridge and microwave was nice as well. Check in was quick and easy, even when we arrived earlier than expected.
No bugs!
The code system for the doors were perfect and much easier than key cards, that can be easy to lose.
I’m a fan of warm water so The only annoying thing was the shower water took a very long time to heat up, or sometimes wouldn’t heat up at all. I’m not sure why, maybe other people were also using hot water at the same time? The sink was fine though! The people who worked at the desk were nice and the other guests were as well. A few homeless people were outside but they weren’t bothering anybody.
The Roku TV was great for playing music and it was logged into a YouTube prime account so free movies!!

Even when it was blazing hot outside they still greeted me each day with amazing energy. Oh, and a tall gentleman (I never got his name) at Gigi for breakfast. I didn’t even have to say what my coffee order was after day two because he remembered. I can’t wait to come back!

Our table wasn’t exactly the easiest group to manage, yet Daisy handled everything with grace, professionalism, warmth, and a great sense of humor. She was attentive without being intrusive, made us feel genuinely welcome, and elevated the entire experience.

In an industry where great service can make all the difference, Daisy stands out. She has a natural ability to connect with people and make them feel taken care of. Our entire group left impressed.

Thank you, Daisy, for making our evening so memorable. Delano is fortunate to have you on their team.

Unfortunately, the service is a disaster. One towel in the room for four people, called for extras and they brought too little. Asked to speak to manager for a late checkout, 5 hours later still hadn’t heard back. No shower facilities. At check out they tried to charge for room twice. The list goes on… but they don’t have their act together, unfortunately.

text.text:
The newly renovated Delano Hotel would be our go to hotel now at the Miami Beach area. The location is amazing, the pool was spectacular and the beach front was beautiful. The rooms, and amenities were done meticulously and I highly recommend staying here.

Not that those are enough reasons to stay here but don’t forget about the amazing team members who will take care of you during your stay. Some names to mention, Jeremy at the pool bar, Tanya at the pool, Ethan and Thomas at the beach. Each and every team member of the Delano will make sure that you are well attended to. The people who helped us out took our stay to the next level!!

We will be back and look forward to staying here again.

Also don’t forget to check out the restaurant on the 4th floor, Mimi Kakushi. The best and most creative drinks in town! And the food is amazing too!
